message:
I see. The ServerHello processing calls `set_client_ciphersuite(s, cipherchars)` which sets the cipher. If the cipher is not in the client's list, this would fail.

Let me check `set_client_ciphersuite`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -n "set_client_ciphersuite" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openssl/ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c | head -3; echo "---"; sed -n '/static int set_client_ciphersuite/,/^}/p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openssl/ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c</parameter>
